messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Telugu) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | A | preposition “to” introducing the addressees | **వారికి** (dative suffix) | “to them” | UNNECESSARY (expressed by case ending) | | le | definite article (plural) | — | — | UNNECESSARY (Telugu has no articles) | | quai | relative pronoun “whom” (the ones) | **వారికి** | “to them / whom” | OK | | poi | adverb “then / thereafter” | **తర్వాత** | “afterwards” | OK | | se | subordinating conjunction “if” | — (conditional encoded in verb) | — | UNNECESSARY | | tu | 2nd‑person singular pronoun “you” | **నీవు** | “you” | OK | | vorrai | future volitional “will want / wilt” | **కోరుకుంటే** | “if (you) want” | OK | | salire, | infinitive “to ascend” | **ఎక్కాలని** | “to ascend” | OK | | anima | noun “soul” | **ఆత్మ** | “soul” | OK | | fia | future copula “shall be” | **ఉంటుంది** | “will be” | OK | | a | preposition “for / to” (introducing the domain) | **విషయానికి** | “for that matter” | OK | | ciò | demonstrative “that” (the ascent) | **ఆ** | “that” | OK | | più | comparative adverb “more” | **ఎక్కువ** | “more” | OK | | di | preposition introducing the standard of comparison “than” | **కన్నా** | “than” | OK | | me | 1st‑person pronoun “I” (comparison baseline) | **నేను** | “I” | OK | | degna: | adjective “worthy” (predicative) | **గౌరవం కలిగిన** | “worthy / having respect” | OK | | con | preposition “with” (accompaniment) | **ఆమెతో** | “with her” | OK | | lei | pronoun “her” | **ఆమె** | “her” | OK | | ti | 2nd‑person pronoun “you” (object) | **నిన్ను** | “you” | OK | | lascerò | future “will leave” | **విడిచిపెడతాను** | “will leave” | OK | | nel | preposition “in” (locative) | — (locative expressed by suffix ‑లో) | — | UNNECESSARY | | mio | possessive adjective “my” | **నా** | “my” | OK | | partire; | infinitive nominalised “departure / journey” | **ప్రయాణం** | “journey / departure” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `A`, `le`, `se`, `nel` – these grammatical elements are encoded in Telugu by case endings or are simply not needed (articles). - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 121: - Original: నీవు తరువాత ఎక్కాలని కోరుకుంటే వారికి, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 122: - Original: అప్పుడ​ా ఆ విషయానికి నేను కన్నా ఎక్కువ గౌరవం కలిగిన ఆత్మ ఉంటుంది: - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
